"""Typed messages between the control plane's workflows and activities (spec §5.3, §5.13).

Plain frozen dataclasses so Temporal's default converter serializes them deterministically, and
the SQLite-WAL reduced mode stores the same shapes as JSON. Nothing here does I/O.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control.states import TERMINAL, IncidentState

# The outcomes an Incident workflow can end with (I3: always one of these).
RESOLVED, ESCALATED, PARKED = (str(s) for s in (IncidentState.RESOLVED, IncidentState.ESCALATED,
                                                IncidentState.PARKED))  # fmt: skip


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ControlConfig:
    """Bounds and pacing of the control plane, passed into workflows (never read from env)."""

    supervisor_id: str = "fleet-supervisor"
    max_rounds: int = 3  # repair rounds per pass (states.Bounds)
    max_canary_reentries: int = 2  # amendment A-5
    max_open_per_host: int = 2  # concurrency limit per host (§5.3.1)
    continue_as_new_every: int = 1000  # FleetSupervisor events per run (§5.3.1)
    canary_p0: float = 0.05  # the host's baseline failure rate (H0)
    canary_ratio: float = 2.0  # H1 = ratio × p0 (§5.12)
    canary_interval_s: float = 300.0  # durable timer between canary batches
    canary_max_batches: int = 48
    anchor_interval_s: float = 3600.0  # AuditAnchor cadence (hourly)
    heartbeat_s: float | None = None  # drills only: overrides every heartbeat timeout


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Hit:
    """A detection hit as the senses deliver it (``kintsugi.senses.store.HitEvent``)."""

    hit_key: str
    detection_id: str
    trace_id: str
    span_id: str
    source: str = "poller"
    receptor: str | None = None
    host: str | None = None
    detected_at: str | None = None
    hit_id: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RouteDecision:
    """The Sentinel's call for one hit: open a new incident or attach to an open one."""

    action: str  # "open" | "attach" | "drop"
    incident_id: str | None = None
    severity: str = "warning"
    reason: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Alert:
    incident_id: str
    host: str
    hits: tuple[Hit, ...]
    severity: str = "warning"
    supervisor_id: str | None = None
    reentries: int = 0
    evidence: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # canary evidence carried into a re-entry (§6.7)

    def with_evidence(self, *items: str) -> Alert:
        return replace(self, reentries=self.reentries + 1, evidence=(*self.evidence, *items))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Signature:
    incident_id: str
    host: str
    phi: str
    trace_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    severity: str = "warning"
    summary: str = ""
    pass_no: int = 0  # 0, then +1 for each canary re-entry: steps of a new pass are new work


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AntibodyMatch:
    antibody_id: str
    version: str
    recipe_sha: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Repro:
    ok: bool
    cassette_sha: str | None
    failures: int
    runs: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Cause:
    suspects: tuple[str, ...]
    intent_record_sha: str | None = None
    report: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BudgetPlan:
    budget_usd: float
    k: int
    max_rounds: int
    tier: str
    plan_sha: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Card:
    incident_id: str
    hypothesis: str  # "H1" … "Hk"
    round: int
    brief: str
    base_sha: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SurgeonOutcome:
    incident_id: str
    hypothesis: str
    attempt: int
    branch: str
    nonce: str
    commit_sha: str | None
    checkpoint_id: str | None = None
    diff_sha: str | None = None
    adopted: bool = False  # attempt N found attempt N-1's commit and kept it (§6.6)
    abandoned: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # abandoned earlier attempts (no commit, no checkpoint)
    cost_usd: float = 0.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GateVerdict:
    hypothesis: str
    passed: bool
    gates: dict[str, bool] = field(default_factory=dict)  # G0…G6
    diff_sha: str | None = None
    reason: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Decision:
    round: int
    winner: str | None = None  # the winning hypothesis
    dispute: bool = False
    experiment_sha: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Shipment:
    incident_id: str
    hypothesis: str
    branch: str
    pr_url: str | None
    g7_ok: bool
    merged: bool
    merge_sha: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CanaryResult:
    accepted: bool
    rejected: bool
    samples: int
    llr: float
    trace_ids: tuple[str, ...] = ()


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AntibodyRef:
    antibody_id: str
    version: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TransitionRecord:
    incident_id: str
    seq: int  # position in the incident's transition log (REPAIRING → REPAIRING repeats)
    source: str
    target: str
    outcome: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Outcome:
    incident_id: str
    state: str
    reason: str
    transitions: tuple[TransitionRecord, ...] = ()
    shipment: Shipment | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if IncidentState(self.state) not in TERMINAL:
            raise ValueError(f"an incident ends in RESOLVED, ESCALATED or PARKED, not {self.state}")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VaccinationResult:
    antibody_id: str
    host: str
    applied: bool
    reason: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StepResult:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

"""Typed messages between the control plane's workflows and activities (spec §5.3, §5.13).

Plain frozen dataclasses so Temporal's default converter serializes them deterministically, and
the SQLite-WAL reduced mode stores the same shapes as JSON. Nothing here does I/O.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control.states import TERMINAL, IncidentState

# The outcomes an Incident workflow can end with (I3: always one of these).
RESOLVED, ESCALATED, PARKED = (str(s) for s in (IncidentState.RESOLVED, IncidentState.ESCALATED,
                                                IncidentState.PARKED))  # fmt: skip


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ControlConfig:
    """Bounds and pacing of the control plane, passed into workflows (never read from env)."""

    supervisor_id: str = "fleet-supervisor"
    max_rounds: int = 3  # repair rounds per pass (states.Bounds)
    max_canary_reentries: int = 2  # amendment A-5
    max_open_per_host: int = 2  # concurrency limit per host (§5.3.1)
    continue_as_new_every: int = 1000  # FleetSupervisor events per run (§5.3.1)
    canary_p0: float = 0.05  # the host's baseline failure rate (H0)
    canary_ratio: float = 2.0  # H1 = ratio × p0 (§5.12)
    canary_interval_s: float = 300.0  # durable timer between canary batches
    canary_max_batches: int = 48
    anchor_interval_s: float = 3600.0  # AuditAnchor cadence (hourly)
    heartbeat_s: float | None = None  # drills only: overrides every heartbeat timeout


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Hit:
    """A detection hit as the senses deliver it (``kintsugi.senses.store.HitEvent``)."""

    hit_key: str
    detection_id: str
    trace_id: str
    span_id: str
    source: str = "poller"
    receptor: str | None = None
    host: str | None = None
    detected_at: str | None = None
    hit_id: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RouteDecision:
    """The Sentinel's call for one hit: open a new incident or attach to an open one."""

    action: str  # "open" | "attach" | "drop"
    incident_id: str | None = None
    severity: str = "warning"
    reason: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Alert:
    incident_id: str
    host: str
    hits: tuple[Hit, ...]
    severity: str = "warning"
    supervisor_id: str | None = None
    reentries: int = 0
    evidence: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # canary evidence carried into a re-entry (§6.7)

    def with_evidence(self, *items: str) -> Alert:
        return replace(self, reentries=self.reentries + 1, evidence=(*self.evidence, *items))


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Signature:
    incident_id: str
    host: str
    phi: str
    trace_ids: tuple[str, ...]
    severity: str = "warning"
    summary: str = ""
    pass_no: int = 0  # 0, then +1 for each canary re-entry: steps of a new pass are new work


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AntibodyMatch:
    antibody_id: str
    version: str
    recipe_sha: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Repro:
    ok: bool
    cassette_sha: str | None
    failures: int
    runs: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Cause:
    suspects: tuple[str, ...]
    intent_record_sha: str | None = None
    report: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class BudgetPlan:
    budget_usd: float
    k: int
    max_rounds: int
    tier: str
    plan_sha: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Card:
    incident_id: str
    hypothesis: str  # "H1" … "Hk"
    round: int
    brief: str
    base_sha: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SurgeonOutcome:
    incident_id: str
    hypothesis: str
    attempt: int
    branch: str
    nonce: str
    commit_sha: str | None
    checkpoint_id: str | None = None
    diff_sha: str | None = None
    adopted: bool = False  # attempt N found attempt N-1's commit and kept it (§6.6)
    abandoned: tuple[str, ...] = ()  # abandoned earlier attempts (no commit, no checkpoint)
    cost_usd: float = 0.0


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class GateVerdict:
    hypothesis: str
    passed: bool
    gates: dict[str, bool] = field(default_factory=dict)  # G0…G6
    diff_sha: str | None = None
    reason: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Decision:
    round: int
    winner: str | None = None  # the winning hypothesis
    dispute: bool = False
    experiment_sha: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Shipment:
    incident_id: str
    hypothesis: str
    branch: str
    pr_url: str | None
    g7_ok: bool
    merged: bool
    merge_sha: str | None = None


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CanaryResult:
    accepted: bool
    rejected: bool
    samples: int
    llr: float
    trace_ids: tuple[str, ...] = ()


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AntibodyRef:
    antibody_id: str
    version: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TransitionRecord:
    incident_id: str
    seq: int  # position in the incident's transition log (REPAIRING → REPAIRING repeats)
    source: str
    target: str
    outcome: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Outcome:
    incident_id: str
    state: str
    reason: str
    transitions: tuple[TransitionRecord, ...] = ()
    shipment: Shipment | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if IncidentState(self.state) not in TERMINAL:
            raise ValueError(f"an incident ends in RESOLVED, ESCALATED or PARKED, not {self.state}")


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class VaccinationResult:
    antibody_id: str
    host: str
    applied: bool
    reason: str = ""


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StepResult:
    name: str
    ok: bool
    detail: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)

"""The control plane's workflows on Temporal (spec §5.3.1, §5.13).

- ``FleetSupervisor``: the long-running singleton. Receives ``hit`` signals, dedupes them,
  routes each through the Sentinel, opens ``Incident`` children within a per-host concurrency
  limit, forwards ``drift``, holds budgets and paused antibodies; ``continue_as_new`` every N.
- ``Incident``: the §5.13 loop. Every state change is a legal ``states.py`` transition, the run
  always ends RESOLVED, ESCALATED or PARKED (I3), and nothing ships without a G0–G6 winner (I1).
- ``Canary``: a Wald SPRT on live-traffic batches, with durable timers between them.
- ``CrossHostMaturation``: applies a candidate antibody to a second matching host.
- ``VaccinationWave``: a motif scan, then per-host application; pausable by signal.
- ``Onboarding``: steps O1–O7 for a new host.
- ``SabotageCampaign``: seals every fault before delivering any, on a schedule; Arena requests.
- ``AuditAnchor``: an hourly ledger anchor; ``continue_as_new`` daily.

Determinism (§5.3.3): workflow code calls no LLM, git, HTTP, clock or random generator, never
iterates a set (hash order differs across worker processes), and waits on durable timers only.
Code changes to running workflows go behind ``workflow.patched("…")``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any

from temporalio import workflow
from temporalio.common import RetryPolicy
from temporalio.exceptions import ApplicationError
from temporalio.workflow import ParentClosePolicy

with workflow.unsafe.imports_passed_through():
    from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
    from kintsugi.control.activities import CREW, SPECS
    from kintsugi.control.states import IncidentState, next_state
    from kintsugi.stats.sprt import SPRT
    from kintsugi.stats.sprt import Decision as SprtDecision

S = IncidentState
SEEN_HIT_MEMORY = 5000  # hit keys remembered across continue_as_new (the store dedupes for good)
L4_REVERIFY_WINNER = "l4-reverify-winner"  # Stage 6: drift before shipping re-checks the winner


async def act(name: str, *args: Any, config: c.ControlConfig, result_type: Any = None) -> Any:
    """Run activity ``name`` with its §5.3.2 contract (timeouts, heartbeat, retries, pool)."""
    spec = SPECS[name]
    heartbeat = spec.heartbeat
    if heartbeat is not None and config.heartbeat_s is not None:
        heartbeat = timedelta(seconds=config.heartbeat_s)
    return await workflow.execute_activity(
        name,
        args=list(args),
        task_queue=spec.task_queue,
        start_to_close_timeout=spec.start_to_close,
        heartbeat_timeout=heartbeat,
        retry_policy=spec.retry_policy(),
        result_type=result_type,
    )


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- Incident


@workflow.defn
class Incident:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.state: str = str(S.OPEN)
        self.transitions: list[c.TransitionRecord] = []
        self.drift: tuple[str, str] | None = None
        self.attached: list[c.Hit] = []
        self.hypotheses: dict[str, int] = {}  # every hypothesis id used, across passes

    @workflow.signal
    def drift_signal(self, repo: str, new_main: str) -> None:
        """L4: main moved under the repair (§6.4)."""
        self.drift = (repo, new_main)

    @workflow.signal
    def attach(self, hit: c.Hit) -> None:
        self.attached.append(hit)

    @workflow.query
    def current_state(self) -> str:
        return self.state

    @workflow.query
    def transition_log(self) -> list[c.TransitionRecord]:
        return list(self.transitions)

    @workflow.run
    async def run(self, alert: c.Alert, config: c.ControlConfig) -> c.Outcome:
        outcome = await self._loop(alert, config)
        await act("ledger_append", {"type": "incident", "incident": alert.incident_id,
                                    "state": outcome.state, "reason": outcome.reason,
                                    "transitions": len(self.transitions)},
                  config=config, result_type=str)  # fmt: skip
        if alert.supervisor_id:
            supervisor = workflow.get_external_workflow_handle(alert.supervisor_id)
            await supervisor.signal("incident_closed", args=[alert.incident_id, outcome.state])
        return outcome

    async def _to(self, incident_id: str, target: S, outcome: str, config: c.ControlConfig) -> None:
        current = S(self.state)
        if next_state(current, outcome) is not target:
            raise ApplicationError(f"illegal transition {current} --{outcome}--> {target}",
                                   non_retryable=True)  # fmt: skip
        record = c.TransitionRecord(incident_id, len(self.transitions), str(current),
                                    str(target), outcome)  # fmt: skip
        await act("record_transition", record, config=config)
        self.transitions.append(record)
        self.state = str(target)

    def _end(self, incident_id: str, reason: str, shipment: c.Shipment | None = None) -> c.Outcome:
        return c.Outcome(incident_id, self.state, reason, tuple(self.transitions), shipment)

    async def _escalate(self, incident_id: str, reason: str, config: c.ControlConfig) -> c.Outcome:
        await act("escalate", incident_id, reason, config=config)
        return self._end(incident_id, reason)

    async def _loop(self, alert: c.Alert, config: c.ControlConfig) -> c.Outcome:
        inc = alert.incident_id
        while True:
            sig = await act("triage", alert, config=config, result_type=c.Signature)
            sig = replace(sig, pass_no=alert.reentries)
            await act("tag_traces", inc, list(sig.trace_ids), "before", config=config,
                      result_type=int)  # fmt: skip
            antibody = await act("match_antibody", sig, config=config,
                                 result_type=c.AntibodyMatch | None)  # fmt: skip
            repro = await act("reproduce", sig, config=config, result_type=c.Repro)
            if alert.reentries == 0:
                if not repro.ok:
                    await self._to(inc, S.PARKED, "g0_not_reproducible_after_3_attempts", config)
                    await act("park", sig, "G0 did not reproduce", config=config)
                    return self._end(inc, "G0 did not reproduce the failure")
                await self._to(inc, S.REPRODUCED, "g0_fails_3_of_3", config)
            cause = await act("attribute", sig, repro, config=config, result_type=c.Cause)
            if alert.reentries == 0:
                if not cause.suspects:
                    await self._to(inc, S.ESCALATED, "attribution_found_no_suspect", config)
                    return await self._escalate(inc, "attribution found no suspect symbol", config)
                await self._to(inc, S.ATTRIBUTED, "cause_report_has_suspect", config)
            plan = await act("plan_budget", sig, cause, config=config, result_type=c.BudgetPlan)
            if alert.reentries == 0:
                if plan.budget_usd <= 0:
                    await self._to(inc, S.ESCALATED, "budget_zero", config)
                    return await self._escalate(inc, "no repair budget (L5)", config)
                await self._to(inc, S.REPAIRING, "budget_positive", config)
            prior = None
            if antibody is not None:  # secondary response: the recipe is the hypothesis source
                prior = f"antibody:{antibody.antibody_id}@{antibody.version}:{antibody.recipe_sha}"
            else:
                prior = await act("fixes_prior", sig, config=config, result_type=str | None)

            if not shipment.g7_ok or shipment.pr_url is None:
                await self._to(inc, S.ESCALATED, "rounds_or_budget_exhausted_or_cheaper_treatment",

            if not shipment.merged:

                                   config)  # fmt: skip

                    continue

                               config)  # fmt: skip

            await act("tag_traces", inc, list(canary.trace_ids), "after", config=config,

                           result_type=c.AntibodyRef)  # fmt: skip

            await workflow.start_child_workflow(

                parent_close_policy=ParentClosePolicy.ABANDON,

            await act("fixes_resolve", sig, shipment, config=config)

    async def _rounds(
        self,
        sig: c.Signature,
        cause: c.Cause,
        plan: c.BudgetPlan,
        prior: str | None,
        config: c.ControlConfig,
    ) -> c.SurgeonOutcome | None:
        history: list[c.GateVerdict] = []
        for rnd in range(min(plan.max_rounds, config.max_rounds)):
            if rnd > 0:
                await self._to(sig.incident_id, S.REPAIRING,
                               "round_failed_rounds_and_budget_remain", config)  # fmt: skip
            cards = await act("hypothesize", sig, cause, plan, rnd, history, prior, config=config,
                              result_type=list[c.Card])  # fmt: skip
            for card in cards:
                if card.hypothesis in self.hypotheses:
                    raise ApplicationError(
                        f"hypothesis {card.hypothesis} reused in {sig.incident_id}",
                        non_retryable=True,
                    )
                self.hypotheses[card.hypothesis] = rnd
            outs: list[c.SurgeonOutcome] = list(await asyncio.gather(*[
                act("surgeon", card, config=config, result_type=c.SurgeonOutcome) for card in cards
            ]))  # fmt: skip
            verdicts: list[c.GateVerdict] = list(await asyncio.gather(*[
                act("audit_gates", out, config=config, result_type=c.GateVerdict) for out in outs
            ]))  # fmt: skip
            decision = await act("coordinate", sig, rnd, verdicts, config=config,
                                 result_type=c.Decision)  # fmt: skip
            if decision.dispute:
                decision = await act("dispute_experiment", sig.incident_id, decision,
                                     config=config, result_type=c.Decision)  # fmt: skip
            if decision.winner is not None:
                passed = {v.hypothesis for v in verdicts if v.passed}
                if decision.winner not in passed:  # I1: only a G0–G6 pass may ship
                    raise ApplicationError(
                        f"winner {decision.winner} did not pass G0–G6", non_retryable=True
                    )
                winner = next(o for o in outs if o.hypothesis == decision.winner)
                if self.drift is None or not workflow.patched(L4_REVERIFY_WINNER):
                    return winner
                # L4 (§6.4): main moved during the round. The winner is re-verified merged
                # onto the new main (its attested commit is never rewritten, A-49); it ships
                # only if it still passes, otherwise the round counts as failed.
                repo, new_main = self.drift
                self.drift = None
                await act("rebase_and_rerun", [winner], repo, new_main, config=config)
                moved = replace(winner, diff_sha=f"{winner.commit_sha}@{new_main}")
                recheck = await act("audit_gates", moved, config=config,
                                    result_type=c.GateVerdict)  # fmt: skip
                if recheck.passed:
                    return moved
                verdicts = [v for v in verdicts if v.hypothesis != winner.hypothesis] + [recheck]
            history.extend(verdicts)
            await act("rewind", outs, config=config)
            if self.drift is not None:  # L4: rebase onto the new main, re-run impacted gates
                repo, new_main = self.drift
                self.drift = None
                await act("rebase_and_rerun", outs, repo, new_main, config=config)
            if await act("budget_exhausted", sig, plan, rnd, config=config, result_type=bool):
                return None
        return None

@workflow.defn
class Canary:
    @workflow.run
    async def run(self, shipment: c.Shipment, config: c.ControlConfig) -> c.CanaryResult:
        sprt = SPRT.regression(config.canary_p0, ratio=config.canary_ratio)
        llr, samples = 0.0, 0
        for batch in range(config.canary_max_batches):
            if batch:
                await asyncio.sleep(config.canary_interval_s)  # durable timer
            failures = await act("canary_sample", shipment, batch, config=config,
                                 result_type=list[bool])  # fmt: skip
            for failed in failures:
                samples += 1
                llr += sprt.step(failed)
                verdict = sprt.decide(llr)
                if verdict is SprtDecision.REJECT:
                    return c.CanaryResult(False, True, samples, llr)
                if verdict is SprtDecision.ACCEPT:
                    return c.CanaryResult(True, False, samples, llr)
        # Out of batches without a boundary: no evidence of a regression at the planned power.
        return c.CanaryResult(True, False, samples, llr)

@workflow.defn

"""The control plane's workflows on Temporal (spec §5.3.1, §5.13).

- ``FleetSupervisor``: the long-running singleton. Receives ``hit`` signals, dedupes them,
  routes each through the Sentinel, opens ``Incident`` children within a per-host concurrency
  limit, forwards ``drift``, holds budgets and paused antibodies; ``continue_as_new`` every N.
- ``Incident``: the §5.13 loop. Every state change is a legal ``states.py`` transition, the run
  always ends RESOLVED, ESCALATED or PARKED (I3), and nothing ships without a G0–G6 winner (I1).
- ``Canary``: a Wald SPRT on live-traffic batches, with durable timers between them.
- ``CrossHostMaturation``: applies a candidate antibody to a second matching host.
- ``VaccinationWave``: a motif scan, then per-host application; pausable by signal.
- ``Onboarding``: steps O1–O7 for a new host.
- ``SabotageCampaign``: seals every fault before delivering any, on a schedule; Arena requests.
- ``AuditAnchor``: an hourly ledger anchor; ``continue_as_new`` daily.

Determinism (§5.3.3): workflow code calls no LLM, git, HTTP, clock or random generator, never
iterates a set (hash order differs across worker processes), and waits on durable timers only.
Code changes to running workflows go behind ``workflow.patched("…")``.

async def act(name: str, *args: Any, config: c.ControlConfig, result_type: Any = None) -> Any:
    """Run activity ``name`` with its §5.3.2 contract (timeouts, heartbeat, retries, pool)."""

@workflow.defn

    def __init__(self) -> None:

        self.drift: tuple[str, str] | None = None
        self.attached: list[c.Hit] = []
        self.hypotheses: dict[str, int] = {}  # every hypothesis id used, across passes

    @workflow.signal
    def drift_signal(self, repo: str, new_main: str) -> None:
        """L4: main moved under the repair (§6.4)."""
        self.drift = (repo, new_main)

    @workflow.signal
    def attach(self, hit: c.Hit) -> None:
        self.attached.append(hit)

    @workflow.query
    def current_state(self) -> str:
        return self.state

    @workflow.query
    def transition_log(self) -> list[c.TransitionRecord]:
        return list(self.transitions)

    @workflow.run
    async def run(self, alert: c.Alert, config: c.ControlConfig) -> c.Outcome:
        outcome = await self._loop(alert, config)
        await act("ledger_append", {"type": "incident", "incident": alert.incident_id,
                                    "state": outcome.state, "reason": outcome.reason,
                                    "transitions": len(self.transitions)},
                  config=config, result_type=str)  # fmt: skip
        if alert.supervisor_id:
            supervisor = workflow.get_external_workflow_handle(alert.supervisor_id)
            await supervisor.signal("incident_closed", args=[alert.incident_id, outcome.state])
        return outcome

    async def _to(self, incident_id: str, target: S, outcome: str, config: c.ControlConfig) -> None:
        current = S(self.state)
        if next_state(current, outcome) is not target:
            raise ApplicationError(f"illegal transition {current} --{outcome}--> {target}",
                                   non_retryable=True)  # fmt: skip
        record = c.TransitionRecord(incident_id, len(self.transitions), str(current),
                                    str(target), outcome)  # fmt: skip
        await act("record_transition", record, config=config)
        self.transitions.append(record)
        self.state = str(target)

    def _end(self, incident_id: str, reason: str, shipment: c.Shipment | None = None) -> c.Outcome:
        return c.Outcome(incident_id, self.state, reason, tuple(self.transitions), shipment)

                    return self._end(inc, "G0 did not reproduce the failure")
                await self._to(inc, S.REPRODUCED, "g0_fails_3_of_3", config)
            cause = await act("attribute", sig, repro, config=config, result_type=c.Cause)

"""What every crew role is given: case files, targets, the model, the senses (spec §5.7).

A role never reaches for global state: the worker builds one :class:`CrewContext` and each role
receives it. Failing traces come through a :class:`TraceSource`: the neatlogs Public API in
production (``records.load_trace`` → ``signature.from_trace``) or the observations a rehearsal
recorded locally (``signature.from_chaos_log``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import threading
import time
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Protocol

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.crew.casefile import CaseFile
from kintsugi.crew.llm import Model
from kintsugi.gates.target import Target
from kintsugi.senses.detections import Binding
from kintsugi.senses.signature import FailureObservation, from_trace
from kintsugi.senses.store import SenseStore


class TraceSource(Protocol):
    def observations(self, alert: c.Alert) -> list[FailureObservation]: ...


class NeatlogsTraces:
    """Failing traces through the neatlogs Public API (Stage 4 client)."""

    def __init__(self, api: Any) -> None:
        self.api = api

    def observations(self, alert: c.Alert) -> list[FailureObservation]:
        from kintsugi.senses.records import load_trace

        found: dict[str, FailureObservation] = {}
        for hit in alert.hits:
            if hit.trace_id in found:
                continue
            obs = from_trace(load_trace(self.api, hit.trace_id), [hit.detection_id])
            if obs is not None:
                found[hit.trace_id] = obs
        return list(found.values())


class LocalTraces:
    """Observations a run recorded as JSON lines (``<dir>/*.jsonl``), keyed by trace id."""

    def __init__(self, folder: Path) -> None:
        self.folder = Path(folder)

    @staticmethod
    def write(folder: Path, name: str, observations: Iterable[FailureObservation]) -> Path:
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = folder / f"{name}.jsonl"
        lines = [json.dumps(vars(o), sort_keys=True, default=list) for o in observations]
        path.write_text("".join(line + "\n" for line in lines), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        return path

    def _index(self) -> dict[str, FailureObservation]:
        index = {}
        for path in sorted(self.folder.glob("*.jsonl")):
            for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
                if line.strip():
                    data = json.loads(line)
                    data["preceding"] = tuple(data["preceding"])
                    data["detection_ids"] = tuple(data["detection_ids"])
                    obs = FailureObservation(**data)
                    index[obs.trace_id] = obs
        return index

    def observations(self, alert: c.Alert) -> list[FailureObservation]:
        index = self._index()
        return [index[h.trace_id] for h in alert.hits if h.trace_id in index]


class IncidentIndex:
    """Incident ids and what each incident is about (host, receptors), shared by workers."""

    def __init__(self, path: Path, *, prefix: str = "INC", first: int = 1) -> None:
        self.path = str(path)
        self.prefix = prefix
        self.first = first
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        Path(self.path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incidents (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, host TEXT, "
                "receptor TEXT, opened_at REAL, n INTEGER UNIQUE)"
            )

    def _db(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        db = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=10.0)
        db.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
        return db

    def open(self, host: str, receptor: str) -> str:
        with self._lock, self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(n), ?) FROM incidents", (self.first - 1,))
            n = int(row.fetchone()[0]) + 1
            incident = f"{self.prefix}-{n:04d}"
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO incidents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (incident, host, receptor, time.time(), n),
            )
            return incident

    def host_of(self, incident: str) -> str | None:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT host FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident,)).fetchone()
        return str(row[0]) if row else None


@dataclass
class CrewContext:
    state: Path  # .state/crew
    targets: Mapping[str, Target]
    model: Model | None = None
    store: SenseStore | None = None
    bindings: Mapping[str, Binding] = field(default_factory=dict)
    traces: TraceSource | None = None
    holdout_identity: Path | None = None  # read only inside the Auditor's G4 activity (I5)
    base_ref: str = "main"
    incident_prefix: str = "INC"
    models: Mapping[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)  # role → model id override
    clock: Callable[[], float] = time.time
    g4_seeds: tuple[int, ...] = (1, 2, 3)  # holdout × seeds = the paired sample (§5.12)

    def case(self, incident: str) -> CaseFile:
        return CaseFile(self.state / "cases", incident)

    def target(self, host: str) -> Target:

"""What every crew role is given: case files, targets, the model, the senses (spec §5.7).

A role never reaches for global state: the worker builds one :class:`CrewContext` and each role
receives it. Failing traces come through a :class:`TraceSource`: the neatlogs Public API in
production (``records.load_trace`` → ``signature.from_trace``) or the observations a rehearsal
recorded locally (``signature.from_chaos_log``).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sqlite3
import threading
import time
from collections.abc import Callable, Iterable, Mapping
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Protocol

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.crew.casefile import CaseFile

from kintsugi.senses.detections import Binding
from kintsugi.senses.signature import FailureObservation, from_trace
from kintsugi.senses.store import SenseStore


class TraceSource(Protocol):
    def observations(self, alert: c.Alert) -> list[FailureObservation]: ...


class NeatlogsTraces:
    """Failing traces through the neatlogs Public API (Stage 4 client)."""

    def __init__(self, api: Any) -> None:
        self.api = api

    def observations(self, alert: c.Alert) -> list[FailureObservation]:
        from kintsugi.senses.records import load_trace

        found: dict[str, FailureObservation] = {}
        for hit in alert.hits:
            if hit.trace_id in found:
                continue
            obs = from_trace(load_trace(self.api, hit.trace_id), [hit.detection_id])
            if obs is not None:
                found[hit.trace_id] = obs
        return list(found.values())


class LocalTraces:
    """Observations a run recorded as JSON lines (``<dir>/*.jsonl``), keyed by trace id."""

    def __init__(self, folder: Path) -> None:
        self.folder = Path(folder)

    @staticmethod
    def write(folder: Path, name: str, observations: Iterable[FailureObservation]) -> Path:
        folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path = folder / f"{name}.jsonl"
        lines = [json.dumps(vars(o), sort_keys=True, default=list) for o in observations]
        path.write_text("".join(line + "\n" for line in lines), encoding="utf-8", newline="\n")
        return path

    def _index(self) -> dict[str, FailureObservation]:
        index = {}
        for path in sorted(self.folder.glob("*.jsonl")):
            for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
                if line.strip():
                    data = json.loads(line)
                    data["preceding"] = tuple(data["preceding"])
                    data["detection_ids"] = tuple(data["detection_ids"])
                    obs = FailureObservation(**data)
                    index[obs.trace_id] = obs
        return index

    def observations(self, alert: c.Alert) -> list[FailureObservation]:
        index = self._index()
        return [index[h.trace_id] for h in alert.hits if h.trace_id in index]


class IncidentIndex:
    """Incident ids and what each incident is about (host, receptors), shared by workers."""

    def __init__(self, path: Path, *, prefix: str = "INC", first: int = 1) -> None:
        self.path = str(path)
        self.prefix = prefix
        self.first = first
        self._lock = threading.Lock()
        Path(self.path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self._db() as db:
            db.execute(
                "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS incidents (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, host TEXT, "
                "receptor TEXT, opened_at REAL, n INTEGER UNIQUE)"
            )

    def _db(self) -> sqlite3.Connection:
        db = sqlite3.connect(self.path, timeout=10.0)
        db.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL")
        return db

    def open(self, host: str, receptor: str) -> str:
        with self._lock, self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT COALESCE(MAX(n), ?) FROM incidents", (self.first - 1,))
            n = int(row.fetchone()[0]) + 1
            incident = f"{self.prefix}-{n:04d}"
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO incidents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (incident, host, receptor, time.time(), n),
            )
            return incident

    def host_of(self, incident: str) -> str | None:
        with self._db() as db:
            row = db.execute("SELECT host FROM incidents WHERE id = ?", (incident,)).fetchone()
        return str(row[0]) if row else None

"""The Surgeon session runner: headless Claude Code in the hypothesis worktree, then an attested
commit (spec §5.7 Surgeon, §4.5.2; plan §2a; amendments A-16, A-17, A-18).

``SurgeonStep`` (Stage 5) owns the attempt algorithm (adopt by nonce, or clean up and issue a
new nonce); this module is its ``SessionRunner``:

1. The protected-path pre-commit hook is installed in the target repository (idempotent).
2. The prompt is rendered from the pinned ``surgeon`` template: the card (root cause, intent
   constraints with verified quotes, allowed files, diff budget), a cause-report excerpt and the
   aggregate feedback of earlier rounds. The nonce is in it, so it lands in the transcript (C4).
3. ``claude -p`` (``claude-sonnet-5-5``) runs in the worktree with Read, Edit, Glob, Grep, the
   repository's test runner and ``entire graph`` only; Entire's hooks record the session.
4. The orchestrator commits what the session's Edit/Write calls explain (A-16), refusing
   protected paths and an unapproved large diff, signs the attestation over the tree, parent,
   role, incident and the prompt hash (A-17), and verifies the ``Entire-Checkpoint`` trailer.

The self-report and session record go to the case file under the Surgeon's own row; the Auditor
can never read them. A refused commit is recorded as the orchestrator's ``refusal`` and the step
returns no commit, so the hypothesis fails its gates instead of failing the incident.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.crew import claude_session, templates
from kintsugi.crew.context import CrewContext
from kintsugi.gates import precommit
from kintsugi.gates.protected_paths import load_policy
from kintsugi.proof import attest
from kintsugi.proof.commit import CommitRefused, orchestrator_commit, prompt_digest
from kintsugi.proof.commit import tool_edited_paths as edited
from kintsugi.sandbox import worktree

MODEL = "claude-sonnet-5-5"


def allowed_tools() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return ("Read", "Edit", "Glob", "Grep", "Bash(python -m pytest:*)", "Bash(entire graph:*)")


def session_env(target_root: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """``python`` is Omega's interpreter (the host runtime is installed there); the worktree's
    package root comes first on ``PYTHONPATH`` so tests import the code being edited."""
    scripts = str(Path(sys.executable).parent)
    return {
        "PATH": scripts + os.pathsep + os.environ.get("PATH", ""),
        "PYTHONPATH": str(target_root),
    }


def _bullets(items: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f'- {i.get("clause")}: "{i.get("quote")}"' for i in items) or "(none)"


def render_prompt(
    card: dict[str, Any], *, incident: str, nonce: str, cause: str, feedback: str
) -> templates.Rendered:
    return templates.render(
        "surgeon",
        incident=incident,
        hypothesis=card["hypothesis"],
        nonce=nonce,
        title=card["title"],
        root_cause=card["root_cause"],
        approach=card["approach"],
        intent_constraints=_bullets(list(card.get("intent_constraints") or [])),
        allowed_files=", ".join(card.get("allowed_files") or []) or "(none)",
        diff_budget=card["diff_budget"],
        cause_excerpt=cause,
        feedback=feedback,
        test_command="python -m pytest -q",
    )


class ClaudeSurgeon:
    """``SessionRunner`` for :class:`kintsugi.control.surgeon_step.SurgeonStep`."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ctx: CrewContext,
        signer: attest.Signer,
        *,
        model: str = MODEL,
        max_budget_usd: float = 4.0,
        timeout_s: float = 2400.0,
        run: Callable[..., claude_session.SessionResult] = claude_session.run,
        require_checkpoint: bool = True,  # False only where Entire is not installed (unit tests)
    ) -> None:
        self.ctx = ctx
        self.signer = signer
        self.model = model
        self.max_budget_usd = max_budget_usd
        self.timeout_s = timeout_s
        self._run = run
        self.require_checkpoint = require_checkpoint

    def _context(self, card: c.Card, brief: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
        view = self.ctx.case(card.incident_id).reader("surgeon")
        symptom = (view.get("symptom", "summary", None) or {}).get("summary", "")
        feedback = {
            name: view.get("feedback", name)
            for name in view.names("feedback")
            if name != card.hypothesis
        }
        cause = f"Symptom: {symptom}\nRoot cause (Coordinator): {brief['root_cause']}"
        return cause, json.dumps(feedback, indent=1) if feedback else "(first round)"

    def run(
        self,
        wt: worktree.Worktree,
        card: c.Card,
        nonce: str,
        attempt: int,
        on_start: Callable[[int], None],
    ) -> str | None:
        brief = json.loads(card.brief)
        target = self.ctx.target(str(brief["host"]))
        case = self.ctx.case(card.incident_id)
        precommit.install(target.repo)
        cause, feedback = self._context(card, brief)
        rendered = render_prompt(
            brief, incident=card.incident_id, nonce=nonce, cause=cause, feedback=feedback
        )
        started = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
        request = claude_session.SessionRequest(
            prompt=rendered.prompt,
            cwd=wt.path,
            allowed_tools=allowed_tools(),
            model=self.ctx.models.get("surgeon", self.model),
            session_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            max_budget_usd=self.max_budget_usd,
            timeout_s=self.timeout_s,
            extra_env=session_env(wt.path / target.package_root),
            append_system_prompt=rendered.system,
        )
        result = self._run(request, on_start=on_start)
        stream = result.stream
        case.add_cost("surgeon", stream.cost_usd, f"{card.hypothesis} attempt {attempt}")
        case.put(
            "surgeon_session",
            card.hypothesis,
            {
                "session": result.session_id,
                "attempt": attempt,
                "exit": result.exit_code,
                "timed_out": result.timed_out,
                "cost_usd": stream.cost_usd,
                "turns": stream.num_turns,
                "tool_uses": len(stream.tool_uses),
                "transcript_sha256": result.transcript_sha256,
                "prompt_sha": rendered.prompt_sha,
                "template_sha": rendered.template_sha,
            },
            by="surgeon",
        )
        case.put(
            "surgeon_report",
            card.hypothesis,
            {"report": (stream.result or {}).get("result")},
            by="surgeon",
        )
        attestation = attest.SessionAttestation(
            nonce=nonce,
            role="surgeon",
            incident=card.incident_id,
            worktree=f"wt/{card.incident_id}/{card.hypothesis}",
            base_sha=wt.base_sha,
            prompt_template_sha=prompt_digest(rendered.prompt),
            t_start=started,
            hypothesis=card.hypothesis,
        )
        try:
            outcome = orchestrator_commit(
                wt.path,
                attestation=attestation,
                signer=self.signer,
                subject=f"fix({card.incident_id}): {brief['title']} [{card.hypothesis}]"[:100],
                body=f"Hypothesis {card.hypothesis}, round {card.round}: {brief['approach']}"[:500],
                policy=load_policy(),
                session_paths=edited(stream.tool_uses, wt.path),
                approved_large_diff=bool(brief.get("approved_large_diff")),
                require_checkpoint=self.require_checkpoint,
            )
        except CommitRefused as refusal:
            case.put(
                "refusal",
                card.hypothesis,
                {"reason": str(refusal)[:1000], "attempt": attempt},
                by="surgeon",
            )
            return None
        case.put(

"""The Surgeon session runner: headless Claude Code in the hypothesis worktree, then an attested
commit (spec §5.7 Surgeon, §4.5.2; plan §2a; amendments A-16, A-17, A-18).

``SurgeonStep`` (Stage 5) owns the attempt algorithm (adopt by nonce, or clean up and issue a
new nonce); this module is its ``SessionRunner``:

1. The protected-path pre-commit hook is installed in the target repository (idempotent).
2. The prompt is rendered from the pinned ``surgeon`` template: the card (root cause, intent
   constraints with verified quotes, allowed files, diff budget), a cause-report excerpt and the
   aggregate feedback of earlier rounds. The nonce is in it, so it lands in the transcript (C4).
3. ``claude -p`` (``claude-sonnet-5-5``) runs in the worktree with Read, Edit, Glob, Grep, the
   repository's test runner and ``entire graph`` only; Entire's hooks record the session.
4. The orchestrator commits what the session's Edit/Write calls explain (A-16), refusing
   protected paths and an unapproved large diff, signs the attestation over the tree, parent,
   role, incident and the prompt hash (A-17), and verifies the ``Entire-Checkpoint`` trailer.

The self-report and session record go to the case file under the Surgeon's own row; the Auditor
can never read them. A refused commit is recorded as the orchestrator's ``refusal`` and the step
returns no commit, so the hypothesis fails its gates instead of failing the incident.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import os
import sys
import uuid
from collections.abc import Callable
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.crew import claude_session, templates
from kintsugi.crew.context import CrewContext
from kintsugi.gates import precommit
from kintsugi.gates.protected_paths import load_policy
from kintsugi.proof import attest
from kintsugi.proof.commit import CommitRefused, orchestrator_commit, prompt_digest
from kintsugi.proof.commit import tool_edited_paths as edited
from kintsugi.sandbox import worktree

MODEL = "claude-sonnet-5-5"


def allowed_tools() -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return ("Read", "Edit", "Glob", "Grep", "Bash(python -m pytest:*)", "Bash(entire graph:*)")


def session_env(target_root: Path) -> dict[str, str]:
    """``python`` is Omega's interpreter (the host runtime is installed there); the worktree's
    package root comes first on ``PYTHONPATH`` so tests import the code being edited."""
    scripts = str(Path(sys.executable).parent)
    return {
        "PATH": scripts + os.pathsep + os.environ.get("PATH", ""),
        "PYTHONPATH": str(target_root),
    }


def _bullets(items: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    return "\n".join(f'- {i.get("clause")}: "{i.get("quote")}"' for i in items) or "(none)"


def render_prompt(
    card: dict[str, Any], *, incident: str, nonce: str, cause: str, feedback: str
) -> templates.Rendered:
    return templates.render(
        "surgeon",
        incident=incident,
        hypothesis=card["hypothesis"],
        nonce=nonce,
        title=card["title"],
        root_cause=card["root_cause"],
        approach=card["approach"],
        intent_constraints=_bullets(list(card.get("intent_constraints") or [])),
        allowed_files=", ".join(card.get("allowed_files") or []) or "(none)",
        diff_budget=card["diff_budget"],
        cause_excerpt=cause,
        feedback=feedback,
        test_command="python -m pytest -q",
    )


class ClaudeSurgeon:
    """``SessionRunner`` for :class:`kintsugi.control.surgeon_step.SurgeonStep`."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        ctx: CrewContext,
        signer: attest.Signer,
        *,
        model: str = MODEL,
        max_budget_usd: float = 4.0,
        timeout_s: float = 2400.0,
        run: Callable[..., claude_session.SessionResult] = claude_session.run,
        require_checkpoint: bool = True,  # False only where Entire is not installed (unit tests)
    ) -> None:
        self.ctx = ctx
        self.signer = signer
        self.model = model
        self.max_budget_usd = max_budget_usd
        self.timeout_s = timeout_s
        self._run = run
        self.require_checkpoint = require_checkpoint

    def _context(self, card: c.Card, brief: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, str]:
        view = self.ctx.case(card.incident_id).reader("surgeon")
        symptom = (view.get("symptom", "summary", None) or {}).get("summary", "")
        feedback = {
            name: view.get("feedback", name)
            for name in view.names("feedback")
            if name != card.hypothesis
        }
        cause = f"Symptom: {symptom}\nRoot cause (Coordinator): {brief['root_cause']}"
        return cause, json.dumps(feedback, indent=1) if feedback else "(first round)"

    def run(
        self,
        wt: worktree.Worktree,
        card: c.Card,
        nonce: str,
        attempt: int,
        on_start: Callable[[int], None],
    ) -> str | None:
        brief = json.loads(card.brief)
        target = self.ctx.target(str(brief["host"]))
        case = self.ctx.case(card.incident_id)
        precommit.install(target.repo)
        cause, feedback = self._context(card, brief)
        rendered = render_prompt(
            brief, incident=card.incident_id, nonce=nonce, cause=cause, feedback=feedback
        )
        started = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(timespec="seconds")
        request = claude_session.SessionRequest(
            prompt=rendered.prompt,
            cwd=wt.path,
            allowed_tools=allowed_tools(),
            model=self.ctx.models.get("surgeon", self.model),
            session_id=str(uuid.uuid4()),
            max_budget_usd=self.max_budget_usd,
            timeout_s=self.timeout_s,
            extra_env=session_env(wt.path / target.package_root),
            append_system_prompt=rendered.system,
        )
        result = self._run(request, on_start=on_start)
        stream = result.stream
        case.add_cost("surgeon", stream.cost_usd, f"{card.hypothesis} attempt {attempt}")
        case.put(
            "surgeon_session",
            card.hypothesis,
            {
                "session": result.session_id,
                "attempt": attempt,
                "exit": result.exit_code,
                "timed_out": result.timed_out,
                "cost_usd": stream.cost_usd,
                "turns": stream.num_turns,
                "tool_uses": len(stream.tool_uses),
                "transcript_sha256": result.transcript_sha256,
                "prompt_sha": rendered.prompt_sha,
                "template_sha": rendered.template_sha,
            },
            by="surgeon",
        )
        case.put(
            "surgeon_report",
            card.hypothesis,
            {"report": (stream.result or {}).get("result")},
            by="surgeon",
        )
        attestation = attest.SessionAttestation(
            nonce=nonce,
            role="surgeon",
            incident=card.incident_id,
            worktree=f"wt/{card.incident_id}/{card.hypothesis}",
            base_sha=wt.base_sha,
            prompt_template_sha=prompt_digest(rendered.prompt),
            t_start=started,
            hypothesis=card.hypothesis,
        )
        try:
            outcome = orchestrator_commit(
                wt.path,
                attestation=attestation,
                signer=self.signer,
                subject=f"fix({card.incident_id}): {brief['title']} [{card.hypothesis}]"[:100],
                body=f"Hypothesis {card.hypothesis}, round {card.round}: {brief['approach']}"[:500],
                policy=load_policy(),
                session_paths=edited(stream.tool_uses, wt.path),
                approved_large_diff=bool(brief.get("approved_large_diff")),
                require_checkpoint=self.require_checkpoint,
            )
        except CommitRefused as refusal:
            case.put(
                "refusal",
                card.hypothesis,
                {"reason": str(refusal)[:1000], "attempt": attempt},
                by="surgeon",
            )
            return None
        case.put(
            "outcome",
            card.hypothesis,
            {
                "commit": outcome.sha,
                "checkpoint": outcome.checkpoint_id,
                "paths": list(outcome.changed_paths),
                "lines": outcome.changed_lines,
                "attempt": attempt,
                "nonce": nonce,
            },
            by="surgeon",
        )
        return outcome.sha

content.content:
"""The Auditor: pass or fail on every gate, blind to the Surgeons (spec §5.7, §5.11).

Reads the card, the attested commit (or the orchestrator's refusal of it), the G0 record and
cassette, the intent record and cause report, and nothing a Surgeon wrote about its own work:
the case file refuses ``surgeon_report`` and ``surgeon_session`` to this role. Order:

1. **Diff check** (anti-gaming, the second half of "protected paths enforced twice"): protected
   paths, the card's allowed files, the diff budget (unless the card records the Coordinator's
   approval), no new outbound network calls.
2. **G1–G4** on clean checkouts of the base and the candidate (or, after upstream drift, the
   candidate merged onto the new main, re-verified per the L4 policy). G4 is skipped once a
   cheaper gate has failed: a discarded hypothesis does not spend holdout evaluations.
3. **G5** with ``claude-opus-5-5`` on the patch and the verified intent record only.
4. **G6** through the governor's view of the cost log.

The full evidence goes to the Coordinator (``verdict/<H>``); Surgeons get ``feedback/<H>``:
failed gates, the flipped visible tests and the replay diff, and G4 as aggregates only.
The holdout identity is read from its file inside the G4 step and never stored (I5).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import threading
from collections.abc import Mapping
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from kintsugi.control import contracts as c
from kintsugi.crew.context import CrewContext
from kintsugi.gates import antigaming, g1, g2, g3, g4, g5, g6
from kintsugi.gates.checkout import clean_checkout, diff_text, merged_checkout
from kintsugi.gates.common import GATES, GateResult, failed, passed
from kintsugi.gates.target import Target
from kintsugi.memory.graph import GraphError
from kintsugi.sandbox.cassette import Cassette

_locks: dict[str, threading.Lock] = {}
_locks_guard = threading.Lock()


def _incident_lock(incident: str) -> threading.Lock:
    """Audits of one incident run one at a time: G4's latency bound compares wall-clock runs,
    which concurrent gate runs of sibling hypotheses would skew."""
    with _locks_guard:
        return _locks.setdefault(incident, threading.Lock())


def skipped(gate: str, why: str) -> GateResult:
    return failed(gate, f"skipped: {why}", skipped=True)


class Auditor:
    def __init__(self, ctx: CrewContext) -> None:
        self.ctx = ctx

    def audit(self, out: c.SurgeonOutcome) -> c.GateVerdict:
        with _incident_lock(out.incident_id):
            return self._audit(out)

    def _audit(self, out: c.SurgeonOutcome) -> c.GateVerdict:
        case = self.ctx.case(out.incident_id)
        view = case.reader("auditor")
        card = view.get("card", out.hypothesis)
        target = self.ctx.target(str(card["host"]))
        repro = view.get("repro", "g0")
        gates: dict[str, GateResult] = {
            "G0": passed("G0", "reproduced 3/3") if repro.get("ok") else failed("G0", "no repro")
        }
        base, head = str(card["base_sha"]), out.commit_sha
        reverify = None
        if out.diff_sha and "@" in out.diff_sha:  # L4: the candidate merged onto a moved main
            reverify = view.get("reverify", out.hypothesis, None)
        diff = None
        if head is None:
            refusal = view.get("refusal", out.hypothesis, None) or {}
            reason = f"no attested commit: {refusal.get('reason', 'the session made none')}"
            for gate in GATES[1:]:
                gates[gate] = skipped(gate, reason)
        else:
            diff = antigaming.check(
                target.repo, base, head, approved_large_diff=bool(card.get("approved_large_diff"))
            )
            outside = [p for p in diff.paths if p not in set(card.get("allowed_files") or [])]
            if outside and card.get("allowed_files"):
                problems = [] if diff.result.passed else [diff.result.summary]
                problems.append(f"edits outside the card's allowed files: {outside}")
                diff = antigaming.DiffCheck(
                    failed("diff", "; ".join(problems), **diff.result.evidence),
                    diff.paths,
                    diff.lines,
                    diff.network,
                )
            if not diff.result.passed:
                for gate in GATES[1:]:
                    gates[gate] = skipped(gate, "the diff check failed")
            else:
                gates.update(self._run_gates(case, card, target, repro, base, head, reverify))
                record = view.get("intent_record", "record", None) or {}
                report = view.get("cause", "report", None) or {}
                gates["G5"] = self._g5(case, out, card, record, report, target, base, head)
                plan = case.reader("governor").get("plan", "plan", None) or {}
                gates["G6"] = g6.within_budget(case.spent(), float(plan.get("budget_usd", 0.0)))
        verdict_ok = all(gates[g].passed for g in GATES)
        reason = "; ".join(f"{g}: {gates[g].summary}" for g in GATES if not gates[g].passed)
        if diff is not None and not diff.result.passed:
            reason = f"diff check: {diff.result.summary}"
        evidence = {
            "hypothesis": out.hypothesis,
            "commit": head,
            "base": base,
            "diff": diff.result.as_dict() if diff else None,
            "diff_lines": diff.lines if diff else 0,
            "gates": {g: gates[g].as_dict() for g in GATES},
            "g4": gates["G4"].evidence if gates["G4"].passed else {},
            "reverify": reverify,
            "passed": verdict_ok,
        }
        case.put("verdict", out.hypothesis, evidence, by="auditor")
        case.put("feedback", out.hypothesis, feedback(gates, diff), by="auditor")
        return c.GateVerdict(
            out.hypothesis,
            verdict_ok,
            {g: gates[g].passed for g in GATES},
            head,
            reason or "G0–G6 pass",
        )

    def _run_gates(
        self,
        case: Any,
        card: Mapping[str, Any],
        target: Target,
        repro: Mapping[str, Any],
        base: str,
        head: str,
        reverify: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    ) -> dict[str, GateResult]:
        view = case.reader("auditor")
        cassette = Cassette.from_dict(view.get("cassette", "g0"))
        tasks = _tasks(target, repro.get("tasks") or [])
        results: dict[str, GateResult] = {}
        onto = str(reverify["new_main"]) if reverify else None
        with (
            clean_checkout(target.repo, onto or base) as before,
            (
                merged_checkout(target.repo, head, onto)
                if onto
                else clean_checkout(target.repo, head)
            ) as after,
        ):
            results["G1"] = g1.build_static(target, after)
            results["G2"] = g2.reproduction_fixed(
                target,
                after,
                cassette,
                tasks,
                list(repro.get("failing") or []),
                seed=int(repro["seed"]),
                split=str(repro["split"]),
            )
            results["G3"] = self._g3(target, before, after, onto or base, reverify)
            if not all(r.passed for r in results.values()):
                results["G4"] = skipped("G4", "a cheaper gate failed")
            elif reverify and not reverify.get("rerun_g4", True) and reverify.get("g4"):
                results["G4"] = passed(
                    "G4", "reused: no impact intersection (L4)", **dict(reverify["g4"])
                )
            else:
                results["G4"] = self._g4(target, before, after, onto or base)
        return results

    def _g3(
        self,
        target: Target,
        before: Path,
        after: Path,
        base: str,
        reverify: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    ) -> GateResult:
        tests = list(reverify.get("tests") or []) if reverify else None
        baseline = self.ctx.state / "baselines" / f"{target.id}-{base[:12]}.json"
        baseline.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            if not baseline.is_file():
                g3.record_baseline(target, before, baseline)
            return g3.no_collateral(target, after, baseline, tests=tests or None)
        except (GraphError, FileNotFoundError, OSError):  # no Entire here: same delta via pytest
            return g3.pytest_flips(
                g3.pytest_results(target, before), g3.pytest_results(target, after)
            )

    def _g4(self, target: Target, before: Path, after: Path, base: str) -> GateResult:
        if self.ctx.holdout_identity is None:
            return failed("G4", "no holdout identity is configured for the Auditor")
        identity = self.ctx.holdout_identity.read_text(encoding="ascii").strip()
        try:
            # Base and candidate run back to back per seed in every audit: a base run cached
            # from an earlier audit was measured under different machine load, which skews the
            # p95 bound (wall-clock latency) in either direction.
            return g4.held_out_efficacy(target, before, after, identity, seeds=self.ctx.g4_seeds)
        finally:
            del identity

    def _g5(
        self,
        case: Any,
        out: c.SurgeonOutcome,
        card: Mapping[str, Any],
        record: Mapping[str, Any],
        report: Mapping[str, Any],
        target: Target,
        base: str,
        head: str,
    ) -> GateResult:
        originating = report.get("originating_commit")
        origin_diff = ""
        if originating:
            origin_diff = diff_text(target.repo, f"{originating}^", str(originating))
        return g5.judge(
            self.ctx.model,
            case,
            hypothesis=out.hypothesis,
            title=str(card.get("title", "")),
            record=record,
            patch=diff_text(target.repo, base, head),
            originating=origin_diff,
        )


def feedback(gates: Mapping[str, GateResult], diff: antigaming.DiffCheck | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """What a Surgeon may see of a verdict: visible-test names, the replay diff, G4 aggregates."""
    out: dict[str, Any] = {"failed": [g for g in GATES if not gates[g].passed]}
    if diff is not None and not diff.result.passed:
        out["diff"] = diff.result.summary
    for gate in ("G1", "G2", "G3", "G5", "G6"):
        if not gates[gate].passed and not gates[gate].evidence.get("skipped"):
            out[gate] = gates[gate].summary
    if "flips" in gates["G3"].evidence:
        out["G3_flips"] = gates["G3"].evidence["flips"]
    if "still_failing" in gates["G2"].evidence:
        out["G2_still_failing"] = gates["G2"].evidence["still_failing"]
    g4_evidence = gates["G4"].evidence
    if "delta_pass" in g4_evidence:  # §5.11: Δpass, the confidence interval and the cost Δ only
        out["G4"] = {
            key: g4_evidence[key]
            for key in ("delta_pass", "ci_before", "ci_after", "cost_delta", "p95_delta")
        }
        out["G4_summary"] = gates["G4"].summary
    return out


def _tasks(target: Target, ids: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    import importlib

    target.make_importable()
    generator = importlib.import_module(f"{target.host.package}.evals.generate")
    pool = {t["id"]: t for t in generator.tasks("train")}
    return [pool[i] for i in ids if i in pool]

            "G0": passed("G0", "reproduced 3/3") if repro.get("ok") else failed("G0", "no repro")
        }
        base, head = str(card["base_sha"]), out.commit_sha
        reverify = None
        if out.diff_sha and "@" in out.diff_sha:  # L4: the candidate merged onto a moved main
            reverify = view.get("reverify", out.hypothesis, None)
        diff = None
        if head is None:
            refusal = view.get("refusal", out.hypothesis, None) or {}
            reason = f"no attested commit: {refusal.get('reason', 'the session made none')}"
            for gate in GATES[1:]:
                gates[gate] = skipped(gate, reason)
        else:
            diff = antigaming.check(
                target.repo, base, head, approved_large_diff=bool(card.get("approved_large_diff"))
            )
            outside = [p for p in diff.paths if p not in set(card.get("allowed_files") or [])]
            if outside and card.get("allowed_files"):
                problems = [] if diff.result.passed else [diff.result.summary]
                problems.append(f"edits outside the card's allowed files: {outside}")
                diff = antigaming.DiffCheck(
                    failed("diff", "; ".join(problems), **diff.result.evidence),
                    diff.paths,
                    diff.lines,
                    diff.network,
                )
            if not diff.result.passed:
                for gate in GATES[1:]:
                    gates[gate] = skipped(gate, "the diff check failed")
            else:
                gates.update(self._run_gates(case, card, target, repro, base, head, reverify))
                record = view.get("intent_record", "record", None) or {}
                report = view.get("cause", "report", None) or {}
                gates["G5"] = self._g5(case, out, card, record, report, target, base, head)
                plan = case.reader("governor").get("plan", "plan", None) or {}
                gates["G6"] = g6.within_budget(case.spent(), float(plan.get("budget_usd", 0.0)))
        verdict_ok = all(gates[g].passed for g in GATES)
        reason = "; ".join(f"{g}: {gates[g].summary}" for g in GATES if not gates[g].passed)
        if diff is not None and not diff.result.passed:
            reason = f"diff check: {diff.result.summary}"
        evidence = {
            "hypothesis": out.hypothesis,
            "commit": head,
            "base": base,
            "diff": diff.result.as_dict() if diff else None,
            "diff_lines": diff.lines if diff else 0,
            "gates": {g: gates[g].as_dict() for g in GATES},
            "g4": gates["G4"].evidence if gates["G4"].passed else {},
            "reverify": reverify,
            "passed": verdict_ok,
        }
        case.put("verdict", out.hypothesis, evidence, by="auditor")
        case.put("feedback", out.hypothesis, feedback(gates, diff), by="auditor")
        return c.GateVerdict(
            out.hypothesis,
            verdict_ok,
            {g: gates[g].passed for g in GATES},
            head,
            reason or "G0–G6 pass",
        )

    def _run_gates(
        self,
        case: Any,
        card: Mapping[str, Any],
        target: Target,
        repro: Mapping[str, Any],
        base: str,
        head: str,
        reverify: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    ) -> dict[str, GateResult]:
        view = case.reader("auditor")
        cassette = Cassette.from_dict(view.get("cassette", "g0"))
        tasks = _tasks(target, repro.get("tasks") or [])
        results: dict[str, GateResult] = {}
        onto = str(reverify["new_main"]) if reverify else None
        with (
            clean_checkout(target.repo, onto or base) as before,
            (
                merged_checkout(target.repo, head, onto)
                if onto
                else clean_checkout(target.repo, head)
            ) as after,
        ):
            results["G1"] = g1.build_static(target, after)
            results["G2"] = g2.reproduction_fixed(
                target,
                after,
                cassette,
                tasks,
                list(repro.get("failing") or []),
                seed=int(repro["seed"]),
                split=str(repro["split"]),
            )
            results["G3"] = self._g3(target, before, after, onto or base, reverify)
            if not all(r.passed for r in results.values()):
                results["G4"] = skipped("G4", "a cheaper gate failed")
            elif reverify and not reverify.get("rerun_g4", True) and reverify.get("g4"):
                results["G4"] = passed(
                    "G4", "reused: no impact intersection (L4)", **dict(reverify["g4"])
                )
            else:
                results["G4"] = self._g4(target, before, after, onto or base)
        return results

    def _g3(
        self,
        target: Target,
        before: Path,
        after: Path,
        base: str,
        reverify: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
    ) -> GateResult:
        tests = list(reverify.get("tests") or []) if reverify else None
        baseline = self.ctx.state / "baselines" / f"{target.id}-{base[:12]}.json"
        baseline.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        try:
            if not baseline.is_file():
                g3.record_baseline(target, before, baseline)
            return g3.no_collateral(target, after, baseline, tests=tests or None)
        except (GraphError, FileNotFoundError, OSError):  # no Entire here: same delta via pytest
            return g3.pytest_flips(
                g3.pytest_results(target, before), g3.pytest_results(target, after)
            )

    def _g4(self, target: Target, before: Path, after: Path, base: str) -> GateResult:
        if self.ctx.holdout_identity is None:
            return failed("G4", "no holdout identity is configured for the Auditor")
        identity = self.ctx.holdout_identity.read_text(encoding="ascii").strip()
        try:
            # Base and candidate run back to back per seed in every audit: a base run cached
            # from an earlier audit was measured under different machine load, which skews the
            # p95 bound (wall-clock latency) in either direction.
            return g4.held_out_efficacy(target, before, after, identity, seeds=self.ctx.g4_seeds)
        finally:
            del identity

    def _g5(
        self,
        case: Any,
        out: c.SurgeonOutcome,
        card: Mapping[str, Any],
        record: Mapping[str, Any],
        report: Mapping[str, Any],
        target: Target,
        base: str,
        head: str,
    ) -> GateResult:
        originating = report.get("originating_commit")
        origin_diff = ""
        if originating:
            origin_diff = diff_text(target.repo, f"{originating}^", str(originating))
        return g5.judge(
            self.ctx.model,
            case,
            hypothesis=out.hypothesis,
            title=str(card.get("title", "")),
            record=record,
            patch=diff_text(target.repo, base, head),
            originating=origin_diff,
        )


def feedback(gates: Mapping[str, GateResult], diff: antigaming.DiffCheck | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """What a Surgeon may see of a verdict: visible-test names, the replay diff, G4 aggregates."""
    out: dict[str, Any] = {"failed": [g for g in GATES if not gates[g].passed]}
    if diff is not None and not diff.result.passed:
        out["diff"] = diff.result.summary
    for gate in ("G1", "G2", "G3", "G5", "G6"):
        if not gates[gate].passed and not gates[gate].evidence.get("skipped"):
            out[gate] = gates[gate].summary
    if "flips" in gates["G3"].evidence:
        out["G3_flips"] = gates["G3"].evidence["flips"]
    if "still_failing" in gates["G2"].evidence:
        out["G2_still_failing"] = gates["G2"].evidence["still_failing"]
    g4_evidence = gates["G4"].evidence
    if "delta_pass" in g4_evidence:  # §5.11: Δpass, the confidence interval and the cost Δ only
        out["G4"] = {
            key: g4_evidence[key]
            for key in ("delta_pass", "ci_before", "ci_after", "cost_delta", "p95_delta")
        }
        out["G4_summary"] = gates["G4"].summary
    return out


def _tasks(target: Target, ids: list[str]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    import importlib

    target.make_importable()
    generator = importlib.import_module(f"{target.host.package}.evals.generate")
    pool = {t["id"]: t for t in generator.tasks("train")}
    return [pool[i] for i in ids if i in pool]
